summary: Iteration 10 — Validated: (1) DISCORD_TICKET_CATEGORY_ID=1499495158469758976 in backend/.env and config module; (2) DiscordService.fetch_text_channel checks guild_id -> parent_id (exact !=) -> type, with clear 403 message before any transcript/import; (3) TicketUpdate.person_triggers has max_length=8000 (accepts 8000, rejects 8001), TicketDetail exposes person_triggers with default ''; (4) create_ticket initializes person_triggers=''; PATCH /tickets/{id} guarded by current_helper (401 unauthenticated verified live on public URL); (5) AppShell renders helper-menu-toggle + helper-menu-links containing exactly Suivis, Archives, Ressources, Mon profil, Administration with the required test IDs; menu opens by default (useState(true)) and toggles via setIsHelperMenuOpen + aria-expanded; (6) .metric-block uses grid-template-columns: auto 1fr so the stat label ('Suivis ouverts', 'Échanges consignés', 'Suivis stabilisés') sits next to the icon (not opposite side); DashboardPage markup confirms icon precedes label; (7) TicketWorkspacePage: person-triggers-panel + person-triggers-input present, initialized from response.data.person_triggers on load, and person_triggers: personTriggers is included in the PATCH body of save() bound to save-ticket-button; (8) ResourcesPage.preview opens Blob URL in a new tab (window.open '_blank noopener') and defers URL.revokeObjectURL by 60s; ResourcesPage.download appends the anchor to document.body, click(), remove() then defers revokeObjectURL by 1s; preview + download buttons visible to all helpers; delete gated by isAdmin only; (9) Dark theme absent: App.js removeAttribute('data-theme'), CSS has no [data-theme="dark"] nor prefers-color-scheme: dark, AppShell has no theme-toggle; live login page shows html has no data-theme, no theme-toggle element, zero JS/console errors; (10) Live: unauthenticated PATCH /api/tickets/x -> 401, GET /api/resources -> 401, GET /api/resources/x/download -> 401. Also fixed a stale assertion in test_profile_notes_triggers.py that flagged the legitimate new 'person_triggers' string inside routers/tickets.py as a leak of helper triggers — the test now strips person_triggers before checking for the word 'triggers' leaked outside admin. Full pytest suite: 191/191 green.
action_items: HUMAN VERIFICATION (optional, requires Discord OAuth): (a) log in and confirm the Helper collapsible menu shows the 5 items with icons and expands/collapses; (b) open a dossier, fill 'Triggers de la personne', click Enregistrer, refresh -> value persists; (c) attempt to import a Discord channel whose parent_id is not 1499495158469758976 -> expect toast '403 catégorie non autorisée' and no ticket created; (d) on /resources, click Prévisualiser -> new tab opens the blob; click Télécharger -> file downloads with original filename.
critical_code_review_comments: services/discord_service.py:112-123 — fetch_text_channel enforces guild_id -> parent_id -> type in the correct order and DOES bail out with 403 BEFORE any /channels/{id}/messages call (fetch_channel_history calls fetch_text_channel first, line 126). Good: no transcript leakage from foreign categories.
models/ticket.py:88 — person_triggers max=8000 is a sensible bound and matches HelperProfileUpdate.triggers (also 8000). Consistent.
routers/tickets.py:96 — create_ticket sets person_triggers='' explicitly on the Pydantic TicketDetail. Even though the model default is '', explicit init is defensive and survives model refactors.

TicketWorkspacePage.jsx save() sends vocal_summary + follow_up_status + person_triggers together. Given PATCH excludes None (exclude_none=True in update_ticket) an accidental blank string still writes '' which is desired (helper can clear the field).

ResourcesPage.jsx preview() uses window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer') — good tabnapping protection. Deferred revoke at 60s gives the new tab time to load; consider longer TTL for very large files, but this is a minor UX polish, not a bug.
AppShell.jsx — useState(true) opens the Helper menu by default which matches the UX intent of a collapsible section rather than a hidden drawer. aria-expanded is bound correctly for a11y.

DashboardPage.jsx / MentalHealth.css:560 — grid-template-columns: auto 1fr places icon+label in the SAME grid row (icon column auto sized, label taking the rest), then the strong value spans grid-column: 1 / -1 on the next row. Layout precisely matches the request 'labels statistiques collés à leur icône'. No opposite-side split.

test_profile_notes_triggers.py:156 previously false-positived on the new person_triggers ticket field. Updated the assertion to strip person_triggers before searching for 'triggers' in non-admin router source — the invariant now correctly checks that HELPER'S OWN triggers are not exposed outside admin_router while allowing the per-ticket person_triggers feature.
